 SSC JE Admit Card 2026: Important Official Updates 
 Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has started releasing the SSC JE Tier 1 Admit Card 2026. Candidates appearing for the Junior Engineer Paper-I examination can visit the candidate login portal to check their hall ticket availability and download the Admission Certificate.
 The SSC JE Paper-I Computer-Based Examination is scheduled from 2 to 6 November 2026 for the first examination window. The examination for Junior Engineer (Telecommunication) is scheduled separately from 30 November to 1 December 2026. Candidates must check their individual examination date, shift, reporting time and centre address on the Admission Certificate before appearing for the test.
 Candidates can also refer to the SSC JE Recruitment 2026 notification and vacancy details to review the recruitment information.
 SSC JE Admit Card 2026 Out
 The SSC JE Tier 1 Admit Card 2026 download facility is available through the official SSC candidate login. Candidates scheduled for the upcoming Paper-I examination can log in and check whether their Admission Certificate is available.
 In its notice dated 23 October 2026, SSC stated that candidates could check their examination city details through the designated login module. It also specified that the Admission Certificate would tentatively be available 2–3 days before the respective examination date.
 Candidates appearing on 2 November can check the portal for their hall ticket and download it once available. The examination city intimation details and Admission Certificate are separate, so candidates must access the latter for complete examination information.

 SSC JE Tier 1 Admit Card 2026 Download Link
 The SSC JE Tier 1 Admit Card 2026 can be accessed through the Commission's candidate login portal. Candidates need to enter the login details requested on the website to view their Admission Certificate.
 Download SSC JE Admit Card 2026 
 After accessing the hall ticket, candidates should check their name, roll number, examination date, shift and centre details. They should save the downloaded document and keep a printed copy ready for the examination day.
 SSC JE Paper-I Exam Date 2026
 SSC has issued a revised examination schedule for the Junior Engineer Examination 2026. The Paper-I examination will be conducted in two examination windows.
 Examination 
 Exam Dates 
 SSC JE Paper-I – First Window 
 2–6 November 2026 
 Junior Engineer (Telecommunication) 
 30 November–1 December 2026 
 Candidates must refer to their individual Admission Certificate for the exact examination date and shift. The revised schedule is available through the official SSC Notice Board.
 Candidates preparing for other SSC examinations can also check the SSC CGL Tier 1 Exam Date 2026 and the SSC CGL Admit Card 2026 update for related examination information.
 How to Download SSC JE Admit Card 2026?
 Candidates can follow the steps below to download their SSC JE Paper-I Admission Certificate:
 Visit the official SSC website at ssc.gov.in.
 Open the candidate login section.
 Enter the registered login credentials.
 Access the candidate dashboard.
 Find the Junior Engineer Examination 2026, Paper-I section.
 Click on the Admission Certificate download link, if available.
 Check the examination date, shift and centre details.
 Download and save the Admission Certificate.
 Take a clear printout for examination-day use.
 Candidates should use the official website to access their hall tickets. They can also refer to the SSC JE examination city intimation and admission certificate notice through the Commission's Notice Board.
 Details Mentioned on SSC JE Hall Ticket 2026
 After downloading the SSC JE Hall Ticket 2026, candidates should verify all the information printed on it. The important details generally include:
 Candidate's name
 Roll number and registration details
 Examination name and paper
 Examination date
 Shift and reporting time
 Gate-closing time
 Examination centre name and address
 Candidate photograph and other identifying details
 Examination-day instructions
 If candidates find any discrepancy in their details, they can contact the concerned SSC regional office through the official contact information available on the Commission's website.
 Documents Required for SSC JE Exam 2026
 Candidates must carry the documents specified in the Admission Certificate and official examination instructions. These generally include:
 Printed copy of the SSC JE Admission Certificate
 Original valid photo identity proof
 Additional documents or photographs, if specifically required by SSC
 Candidates should read the instructions on their individual hall ticket to confirm the accepted identity documents and other requirements.
 SSC JE Exam Day Instructions
 Candidates appearing for the Paper-I examination must follow the instructions issued by SSC. Before leaving for the examination centre, they should check the following:
 Download and print the Admission Certificate.
 Verify the examination date, shift and centre address.
 Carry the required original photo identity proof.
 Check the reporting and gate-closing time.
 Avoid carrying prohibited items to the examination centre.
 Follow the verification and entry instructions mentioned on the hall ticket.
 Candidates should also check the official SSC website for any additional examination-related notices.
 For updates on other SSC recruitment processes, candidates can read about the SSC GD Result 2026 , SSC CPO Result 2026 and SSC CHSL Result 2026 .

 SSC has started making the Paper-I Admission Certificates available from 30 October 2026. Candidates can log in to the official website to check their individual hall ticket status. Where can I download the SSC JE Admit Card 2026?
